property_summary: For any externally-sent nonzero ETH from any EOA sender, calling C.receive (a plain payable transfer to the contract) always succeeds and increments depositsCount by 1 in the reference; the mutant that forces receive() to revert will instead cause the call to fail (or not increment depositsCount) for some funded input and sender, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Add reverting behavior by requiring false, making receive always revert and thus not change depositsCount.
